recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-27131 unless the work group wants a broader redesign of SubscriptionStatus event-numbering guidance beyond this resolved inclusive-count wording.
issue_request: FHIR-27131 was a Published/Persuasive R5 Subscription change request asking the Subscription Status text to say SubscriptionStatus.eventsSinceSubscriptionStart counts unique notification-triggering events inclusive of the current notification, rather than only prior to it.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 798d44a3d77a03b78f80e45aff6b6187e236de71, which changed source/subscription/subscription-notes.xml from "PRIOR to the current notification" to "inclusive of the current notification." Later Subscription and SubscriptionStatus refactors moved the relevant guidance into the active SubscriptionStatus resource and notes.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists subscription, subscriptionstatus, and subscriptiontopic as active resources. The current SubscriptionStatus definition says eventsSinceSubscriptionStart is generated since Subscription creation inclusive of this notification, and the SubscriptionStatus Event Numbering notes say the value is inclusive of this notification with the first event notification carrying one. The Subscriptions framework points readers to SubscriptionStatus Event Numbering for tracking details instead of repeating the old local sentence. FHIR-I minutes confirm the persuasive vote, and later Zulip discussion quotes the same inclusive wording without contradicting it.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active source already conveys the requested inclusive semantics and no active source text was found that says the count is only prior to the current notification.

related_jiras.note: Later event-numbering work distinguished best-effort and guaranteed-delivery behavior while preserving the inclusive count semantics for best-effort notifications.
Later SubscriptionStatus documentation work linked and consolidated event-numbering guidance around the active SubscriptionStatus page.
